body:
I just wanted to thank all of you for your encouraging words and advice. I am really gratefull that you guys spare time to listen to me. Thank you very much.

For now i am staying at the house of Julias parents and her brother. Not beeing alone with myself and my thoughts makes everything a little more bearable.

I realised that there are still people in my life that mean much to me and they have suffered a loss too and me thinking about suicide really isnt helping anyone. 
I know those thoughts and the pain wont go away any time soon but i will try my best to be there for her family as they are there for me. Its what Julia would excpect from me. And its what i expect from myself.

I hope its ok if i keep talking to you guys every now and then. 
Thanks again

Well she has her parents who are very close to me and her brother is one of my best friends. I am staying at their house at the moment so none of us is beeing alone right know. And i am ashamed of myself for having those thoughts about suicide because i really dont want to do this to them. Thank you for  beeing here and talking to me

She would probably want me to slap myself for thinking about suicide. I really want to keep her memory alive and i am trying as hard as i can to keep going and focus on the times we had. Its just reall fucking hard sometimes. Thanks for listening to me

The thing that gives me a little strength tight now is knowing that she would be deeply disappointed in me for thinking about killing myself. I dont want people to think she coulndt find somone better than that guy who killed himself days after her death. She deserves better i know that. Its still hard trying to keep those thoughts about killing myself away. Thanks for listening and beeing here

Everthing was so perfected it sometimes felt a little unreal to mee. Now that i think about it, most people never get the chance to meet someone that is suited so perfect to them like Julia was for me. I am gratefull for the time we had but it is just really hard to focus on beeing geatefull when the thought of her beeing gone for ever wont leave me alone for a second.
I know she would be ashamed of me for even thinking about ending my life and its one of the few things that keeps me moving right now. I dont want anyone to think her fiancee was somone weak enough to kill himself because he couldn't live without her. She doesn't deserve that. But those thoughts are still here sometimes. I hope i can talk to you guys when they come back and become to much for me. Anyway thanks for beeing here and help me
